references.text: Here the same number of seventy persons who came to Egypt from Jacob's lineage is mentioned, confirming the number that went down to Egypt.
Moses reminds the people of Israel that their ancestors numbered seventy when they went down to Egypt, and now the Lord has made them as numerous as the stars in the sky.
This text gives a detailed list of all of Jacob's descendants who came to Egypt and confirms the total number of seventy persons.
Here it is told how Joseph was sold into Egypt by his brothers, which explains why Joseph was already in Egypt when the rest of the family arrived.
Joseph reveals his identity to his brothers and reminds them that they sold him into Egypt, explaining his presence there before the family's arrival.

Stephen quotes in his speech that Joseph sent word and brought his father Jacob and all his relatives, who were seventy-five persons. This shows an alternative tradition for the number that came to Egypt.
Complementary counts that together give the complete picture of Jacob's household (66 went + 4 already in Egypt = 70).
